# n-header

> Grid-based header with leading, label, and trailing slot regions.

**CSS-only element** — styled purely via CSS, no JavaScript class required.

## Usage

### Minimal

```html
<n-header></n-header>
```

### Examples

```html
<n-header>
          <span>Card Title</span>
        </n-header>
```

```html
<n-header>
          <nav>
            <n-badge intent="accent">New</n-badge>
          </nav>
          <span>Card with Actions</span>
          <aside>
            <n-button variant="ghost"><n-icon name="dots-three"></n-icon></n-button>
          </aside>
        </n-header>
```

```html
<n-header>
            <span>Default (start)</span>
          </n-header>
```
